notes.content:

Reminder: the release discount ends in two hours.

notes.title: Captain’s Log #7 - Command Center
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwG5tOD05kkfFbpu/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Captain's Log, Earth, Day before departure.[/h1]

Last check on the Command Center before joining the Stasis Bay. After that Gemini will be in command until I wake up. 

Steam now allows developers to stream their game via the store pages. Ground control plans to try that new feature for the Launch tomorrow 14th of February 2018 on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/286300/Algo_Bot/]Algo Bot’s Steam page[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31583650/4de90b9bd0b70c5d23e8cebd6b813d5247229c51.jpg[/img]

Thank you for following this Captain’s Log. See you on the far side of the galaxy.

notes.title: Captain's Log #2 - Warehouse
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs4otyVjkK5mPmsU/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Captain's Log, Earth, Six days before departure.[/h1]

notes.title: Captain's Log #1 and Live Stream with the Devs
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/26DMZ9dx7WvJNd9Bu/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Captain's Log, Earth, One week before departure.[/h1] 

Our destination is planet Cactus 2.0 on the far side of the galaxy. My orders are to lead the pan-galactic colonization ship Europa, safely to its destination. I am still somewhat in awe of its size and complexity.  

Ground control plans to have a Launch Party on Wednesday February 14, 2018 . Happy Valentine's Day ːpaleyebrowsː. Feel free to join them on http://www.twitch.tv/fishingcactus

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31583650/6a14dcf8db0e38c8fe219fd4a2bffd05c5a18523.jpg[/img]
